info.title: ECHO (hand-authored) - Air Pollutant Report CSV Download
info.description: HAND-AUTHORED, not an EPA-published schema. Written 2026-11-02 from the behavior of the live service and from how the echo.epa.gov front end calls it. Only parameters that were exercised against the live service are listed; the service may accept or ignore others, and it can change without notice. Route caa_poll_rpt_rest_services.get_caa_csv, used by the ECHO Air Pollutant Report download button. The documented get_caapr route rejects output=CSV (HTTP 200 with an error), and no other documented route returns this table as CSV, so it is added here. p_id is an FRS registry ID; the service itself returns only the header row for a missing or unmatched id. Columns: registry_id, air_program, pgm_sys_acrnm, pgm_sys_ids, pollutant_name, unit_of_measure, one column per year, nei_type, nei_hap_voc_flag.

get.description: Returns the facility air pollutant emissions table as a CSV file.
